text:
Anya: quick sync — AcmeRetail asked for eval-triggered alerts when quality drops + per-customer quantization recommendations. They want this in the Optimize toolkit pilot. Need launch criteria by EOD Fri. thoughts?
Matt: doable but quant recs need model artifacts + offline eval harness. batching/caching recs are much faster to ship.
Chris: quant recs require offline profiling + accuracy sims. Rough estimate: 3 sprints to reach safe, auditable thresholds for two model families.
Sophia: alert infra wise we need eval hooks that emit metrics per request or per-batch. Also need threshold config + suppression (flapping) rules.
Kevin: customers expect actionable recs (e.g., "use q8 with fallback to fp16 if delta > 0.02"), not vague suggestions.
Luna: AcmeRetail will pilot on Dedicated capacity; their SREs insist on automatic fallback to a non-quantized variant if errors/regressions spike.
Anya: proposed phased scope: M0 = batching & cache recommendations + an eval-alert surface that notifies on degradations (manual triage). M1 = automated quantization recommendations with canary + rollback. Acceptance by customer required at M1.
Matt: propose measured metrics for acceptance: latency p50/p95, tokens/sec, model-concordance delta (vs baseline), alert precision on eval sets. Rollout plan: canary at 5% -> 25% -> 100% traffic with automated rollback on regressions.
Chris: sample minimal alert rule we can implement for pilot:
```yaml
eval_alert:
  model: llama-70b
  metric: rouge_l_on_eval_suite
  threshold: 0.12
  window: 500
  action: notify_and_run_fallback
```
Kevin: UI ask from Acme: view recs, approve toggles, and per-customer audit trail. That is product scope.
Anya: tradeoff call: UI vs webhooks/docs for pilot. UI is ~2 weeks dev; docs+webhooks is much faster. Recommend docs+webhooks for pilot to validate signal.
Luna: Acme can accept webhooks initially if we provide a simple dashboard export (CSV) and manual overrides.
Matt: engineering preference aligned: ship docs + webhook + simple CSV export for pilot. Build Console UI for GA once signals stabilize.
Sophia: operational constraints: we need isolation for per-customer eval jobs (Dedicated pool), rate limits on eval-triggering, and backpressure when eval queue grows.
Chris: for quant recs we need a small suite of eval prompts (canonical customers + synthetic edge cases). We should run simulated quant to estimate delta before recommending.
Anya: proposed launch criteria (pilot):
- Batching/caching recs delivered and integrated into Console docs
- Eval-hook emits metrics to Ops & CS for pilot customer
- Alert rule engine able to run on eval outputs and send webhook notifications
- Fallback path tested: quant -> rollback to fp16/FP32 with no more than 2% quality delta for 95% of requests
- Customer (Acme) signs off on pilot acceptance tests
Matt: dev tasks rough split:
- infra (Sophia): eval hook + rate-limiting + isolation
- eng (Matt): endpoint for recs + webhook delivery + CSV export
- ML (Chris): profiling pipeline + recommendation heuristics for two model families
- product (Anya/Kevin): docs + customer runbook + triage flow
Luna: CS will prepare customer acceptance checklist and dataset for eval-suite by Wednesday.
Anya: action items: @Matt spin up proposal PR for webhook schema; @Chris draft profiling plan with cost estimate; @Sophia outline operational limits and SLOs; @Kevin coordinate Acme sign-off window. I'll synthesize launch criteria doc and share.
deploy-bot: reminder — infra maintenance scheduled Thu 02:00 UTC; could affect Dedicated eval jobs if not windowed.
Matt: noted — we'll add gating to avoid running heavy evals during maintenance window.
Anya: thanks everyone — I'll capture these in a short spec and ping for review. If no objections by EOD Fri, we lock pilot scope: docs+webhooks+eval-alert surface + batching/caching recs; quant recs move to M1.
